messages:
inc-bot: alert created for paging-gateway (high priority)
laura: I didn’t get the page — anyone else?
devon: same, oncall phone silent. I see the webhook event in the ingestor logs though
mike: looking at notify-proxy, worker count is 0 for the last 2m, queue length 4k
ops-runner: that matches customer reports — several customers show no delivered pages in the window
laura: @devon can you tail the webhook worker logs and paste any errors?
devon: pasted: `2026-03-18T10:02:14Z error signing webhook: token rotate mismatch` then `panic: nil pointer` once, workers crashed and didn't restart
ops-runner: oof, autoscaler didn’t spin them back up because healthcheck endpoint returned 503 during restart loop
natalie: customer-impact: 12 customers on Dedicated and 27 hosted API requests were not paged between 10:01–10:08 UTC. Support is triaging now.
laura: manual mitigation: can someone trigger fallback path? we need to page oncall via sms/voice until fix deployed
mike: on it — `./scripts/send-fallback-pages --group oncall-ops --via sms,voice` (ran at 10:06)
inc-bot: fallback pages sent to oncall-ops via sms at 10:06:42 (no ack)
laura: ok we got SMSs now, oncall responded and started coordinating
devon: quick hotfix candidate: revert signing-rotation commit that landed 2h ago — that introduced a bool parse change. Will open PR with revert
ops-runner: also added a k8s liveness probe tweak to avoid the restart loop until we fix code
mike: rolling restart of notify-proxy workers done at 10:12 — worker count restored to expected, backlog drained to 0 by 10:17
laura: can someone confirm pages are now going through?
inc-bot: sample delivery log: `DELIVERED page_id=pg_12345 to +1xxx at 10:15:03`
natalie: support confirmed 39/39 missed pages were delivered via fallback and 3 customers reported delayed alerts but no functional outage to end-users other than paging delay
laura: root cause summary: signing rotation parse regression caused webhook workers to panic and not recover; autoscaler/healthcheck interaction prevented automatic recovery; fallback automation did not trigger due to worker crash leaving the router in a nominal state
devon: action items: 1) revert commit and deploy hotfix (in progress), 2) add graceful handling for signing-rotation parse errors, 3) make fallback automation rely on router liveness + queue depth, 4) postmortem and customer follow-up
ops-runner: I’m adding a temporary monitor to alert if worker count=0 for >30s and we’ll run a canary test of paging automation after hotfix
atalie: notifying affected customers with timeline and mitigation at T+1h
laura: good. thanks everyone. change to P0->P1 after hotfix verified.
inc-bot: incident closed at 10:20:55 by laura (manual closure)
laura: short note for follow-up doc: include the exact revert PR number, the metric thresholds used by fallback automation, and test coverage for signing token parsing
laura: (thumbsup)
